modes.name: Gift Slingshot
modes.agent_progress: Playable native Gift Slingshot: source-driven charge/release, vertical keyboard/touch targeting, boat and iceberg spawning/collisions, pooled presents, scores/time bonuses, 10 levels, pause/restart/resize (including overlapping refill callbacks after rapid restart and the full ten-level finish) and original assets/audio actions. Seven original-JavaScript scenarios match at 1e-7; original/native idle capture mean RGB error 0.282/255 at 1440x800. Original queued desktop tutorial now implemented with source delay, dismissal and animation artwork. Corrected intrinsic SVG background sizing/centering and first-boat canvas padding; premultiplied texture filtering/mipmaps now match the source more closely at six widths. Elf ROI error reduced 29–36%, with full-frame error also reduced at every tested width. Production-compositor comparison harness now covers 1440, 1280, 980, 900, 768 and 375px widths. 120-frame release profile averaged 16.77ms intervals and 0.79ms main-thread work. Score/splash effects now follow the original CSS clocks, easing, transform origins, integer border widths, pooled reuse and shortened reversals. 22 browser phase samples and eight lifecycle states match; pause freezes the score while splash transitions continue, and restart preserves active effects.
agent_known_issues: Score/splash raster edges and text antialiasing still differ slightly from Chromium; additional device/input and effect combinations remain unverified.
No claim of whole-mode 1:1 parity; audio actions translated but full music/bus fidelity remains partial.

Remaining SVG/primitive edge coverage differs from Chromium; diagonal ropes and additional animation phases still need matching. Supersampling and blanket MSAA were tested but not retained because some comparisons worsened.

modes.name: Code Boogie
modes.agent_progress: Native Code Boogie now includes the nine source dance classes and three randomly selected freestyle stages, draggable step/repeat blocks, run/retry/continue, original stage/character sprite sheets, BPM-driven dance playback, countdown sound actions and six original idle/performance tracks. Source evaluateStatus/createAnimationQueue results match 54 cases across all nine classes; model validation also rejects empty repeat bodies, extra root stacks and freestyle programs over 32 moves. Chooser corrected against original DOM at four viewport sizes: source background, asymmetric artwork, Roboto captions/descriptions, title letter spacing/shadow, entrance and hover transitions. Preserved teacher artwork aspect ratio and increased chooser SVG raster resolution. Added source-driven floor/ceiling lighting, move-card carousel, title/countdown span animation, watcher transforms and strict millisecond sprite clocks. Replaced the simplified scheduler with a native translation matching 2,775 source-browser snapshots in 15 scenarios, including all lesson intros through completion, interruptions and cross-stage switches. Twelve source DOM states and 59 CSS phases match; ten matched stage stills have mean RGB errors about 0.96–1.43/255. A live connected two-block program reached Nice moves. Educational View code now preserves source loop structure, postorder variable names and execution-time snapshots; 98 full-string comparisons against actual Blockly pass. Result panels now use original flex sizing, glyph metrics, artwork, repeat hint, purple button shapes, delayed child transitions and source invalid-parent-transition behavior. 70 DOM configurations at seven sizes and 96 CSS phases (including reversals) match; 12 isolated captures have mean RGB error 0.046–0.875/255. Code pane label/font/border/clipping/scrolling restored; a controller/render diagnostic verifies the submitted code survives an edit during playback. Freestyle continuation now starts teacher mode as in the source. Final-level Continue now opens the production shared game-over overlay over the retained last scene, with the original header restart action. 29 real browser host states match; owned native composite captures verify controller retention/reset and rendering. Preserved original no-op host restart and ongoing stage clock; disabled scene filtering stays live rather than caching a frozen frame.
agent_known_issues: Initial playable port, not 1:1: full Blockly editor behavior, nested repeat layout, touch/keyboard/accessibility and responsive tray/chooser transitions remain incomplete.

Original share-string import/export and share button, tutorial GIF/video queues, complete textarea interaction/complete host game-over presentation/lifecycle and full music-bus ducking/multi-source failure sounds remain unfinished.

Stage logic and selected CSS phases/stills are checked, but full gameplay-image phase coverage, CSS reversal combinations, image-load/color retry races, route lifecycle, responsive tray, chooser exit and audio presentation remain incomplete. No full-scene 1:1 certification.
Educational code matches supported enabled graphs; disabled/imported types, comments, RTL and textarea soft-wrap/scrollbars/resize/selection/copy and keyboard access remain unfinished.

Result layout/transitions and selected raster phases are checked; broader pressed/focus/device/locale/controller combinations and actual drag/click integration remain unverified. Source-sized share button is not yet provided by live native specs; whole-result 1:1 is not certified.

Completion core is connected; shared overlay focus ring/title raster, blur approximation, keyboard/device/route/orientation/microtask timing and audio remain incomplete or unverified. Callback-driven captures are not full interactive playthroughs.

Final-level Continue now opens the production shared game-over overlay over the retained last scene, with the original header restart action. 29 real browser host states match; owned native composite captures verify controller retention/reset and rendering. Host restart returns to the first jigsaw; removed the invented R shortcut.

changes: Lottie artwork now uses centered uniform aspect fitting, fixing stretched recommendation art across game-over, menu and village cards.
Santa Selfie and its action icons now retain premultiplied alpha from image decoding through filtering and drawing; spray source-atop and decoration source-over blending updated consistently.
Village/card Lottie playback no longer drops fractional frame changes below half a source frame.
Selfie reuses its beard surface only when the complete visible point state and target size are identical; solver constraint iteration no longer clones lists.
Added opt-in live frame profiler; does not measure input-to-photon latency or change simulation steps.
Original action-game tutorial queues and cloud artwork translated to Rust; Ski tutorial uses original video frames with sample aspect preserved.
Pause/game-over responsive geometry matches 18 source cases, including short-landscape row layout; corrected below-content fade/translation and title punctuation.
Final opaque output pass GPU-verified: every RGB byte preserved and all final alpha bytes 255.
Added native Elf Maker and Elf Jamband, with source-state/geometry/animation comparisons.
Shared identical Shapes GPU resources to avoid Macroquad's 32-pipeline startup limit.
Maker software drop-shadow cost isolated and moved to a GPU Gaussian kernel; idle frame intervals improved to about 60 fps without changing animation clocks.
Restored the shared selector in activity scenes; Jamband and Maker hamburger/card navigation release checks pass.
Added Elf Glider with source simulation, CSS lifecycle/sprite, responsive screenshot and motion-threshold comparisons.
Added native Penguin Dash with ten source levels, real-Phaser state/body/player-frame comparisons, original video frames and responsive captures.
Added initial native Code Lab and Code Boogie editors/gameplay with original data/art, source movement/dance evaluation checks, host routing/Home, level counts and shared recommendation eligibility.
remaining: Thirteen native scenes remain partial; 42 source scenes have no native implementation.
Other modes still need individual edge/capture checks. Existing shared edge bleed and opaque target copy remain active.
Whole-site smoothness and minimum input latency are not verified; presentation stalls contaminated post-change desktop profiles.
Cold village image/Lottie parsing and first-use Ogg decode still run on the main thread.
Overlay font raster/bold treatment, card asset loading/fades and every transition phase still need comparison.
evidence: Owned release smoke: Boatload tutorial delay/next hint, key dismissal and pause/resume; all saved output alpha 255.

agent_tracking.visibility: Only Dec 24 10:00 UTC through Dec 25 11:00 UTC (exclusive), per user request. No off-season tracker details through the visibility-gated API.
agent_tracking.progress: 420-stop original route schedule, year skew, great-circle interpolation, distance, heading, presents, stop timings and nearest-stop calculations translated to Rust; 3,020 source states and seasonal boundaries tested. Native tracker controller now includes one-second adjusted clock, marker visibility and active/20 fading trails, current/temporary destination selection, visited feed-stop IDs, 20-second auto-refocus, source camera zoom/pan commands, mobile gesture controls and exact English stats formatting. 3,020 original StopManager states, 18 controller states, 12 clock adjustments and formatter/nearest-arrival cases match. Photo attribution metadata is retained in typed route details. Isolated native Santa renderer now includes eight directional three-layer sprites, source per-keyframe easing, responsive sizes, two original animated chimney GIFs, falling-present artwork and grouped drop shadows. 84 actual-browser direction/bounce samples, stop/show animation lifecycle and all 72 independently decoded GIF frames are checked. This is a comparison preview, not an integrated tracking screen.
remaining: Native map and tracker screen are not implemented; controller commands are available to a future native renderer.
Google Maps tiles/overlays, feed/media playback, photo loading/animation, persistent route cache, remote config, online refresh and native geolocation remain unfinished.
Native Google map tiles require a separately configured provider key; no user key is currently available. No original website key is reused or embedded.
Santa preview still has SVG edge/shadow raster differences; all map interactions and combined tracker layout remain unverified.
agent_tracking.next_work: Integrate native tracking layout/controller, stats and map renderer; provider key is unavailable, so live Google tiles cannot yet be verified. Finish original/native Santa edge/shadow comparisons and broader animation phases.
